# Print layout references (layout only)

Third-party samples stored here for **layout comparison only**. Do not seed or hardcode their seller names, VAT numbers, addresses, or line items in the app.

| File | Template | Notes |
|------|----------|--------|
| `plumber-template-A.pdf` | A — Modern | Two-page tax invoice (seller header, buyer table, lines, totals + QR footer) |
| `plumber-template-A-page-1.png` | A — Modern | Page 1 screenshot (add when available in repo) |
| `plumber-template-A-page-2.png` | A — Modern | Page 2 screenshot (totals / QR / footer) |
| `plumber-template-B.jpg` | B — Classic | Single-page classic ZATCA-style grid |

Live rendering uses **Business settings** (seller) and issued **invoice / quotation** payloads (buyer + lines). Choose template per document type under **Admin → Business settings → Z-Heart / Invoicing**.
